level.theme: Mysterious — the environment breathes. Coral glows in response to the player’s presence. Stone statues weep black water. Distant chimes echo — sometimes from ahead, sometimes from behind. No dialogue. Only ambient sound: water pressure, shifting stone, and the low, mournful hum of the Leviathan’s song.
level.setting: A drowned civilization of geomancers who sought to bind the ocean’s tides to stone. Their failures birthed the Leviathan — a corrupted guardian now fused with the planet’s geomantic ley lines. The player is the last descendant, drawn by the haunting echoes of their ancestors’ last incantation.
level.player_weapon: Stone-Splitter — a gauntlet that channels seismic energy to fracture stone, summon tremors, and create temporary platforms

encounters.location: Sunken Ruins of the Tidal Spire — collapsed coral arches, broken statues, drifting sandstorms

enemy.name: Silt Wraith
enemy.weakness: Susceptible to seismic pulses from the Geomancer’s Stone-Splitter — a weapon that fractures rock and destabilizes sediment

encounters.hazard: Thick, clinging silt reduces visibility and slows movement — activates when player enters the chamber

pickup.name: Resonance Compass
pickup.effect: Reveals hidden pressure plates and reveals the path to Encounter 1 by vibrating faintly when near geomantic conduits

encounters.trigger: Player enters the chamber through the collapsed arch — silt activates, and the Silt Wraith emerges from the seabed.

encounters.location: The Whispering Garden — bioluminescent coral forests with pulsing veins of blue light

enemy.name: Coral Revenant
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to harmonic frequencies — the Resonance Compass emits a pulse that causes its calcified limbs to crack and splinter

encounters.hazard: Living coral grows rapidly when disturbed, forming walls and traps — slows player if not countered with precise seismic pulses

pickup.name: Echo Shard
pickup.effect: When held, emits a soft chime that reveals weak points in the coral architecture and the location of the next chamber's entrance — also allows player to 'tune' the environment to their frequency

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Silt Wraith, the Resonance Compass vibrates intensely, revealing a hidden tunnel beneath the floor — the coral begins to writhe as the Revenant rises from the central spire.

encounters.location: The Fractured Trench — jagged basalt pillars, collapsed aqueducts, and swirling vortexes of silt and debris

enemy.name: Tidebreaker Golem
enemy.weakness: Its stone shell is brittle when struck at the exact frequency emitted by the Echo Shard — resonant strikes cause cascading fractures

encounters.hazard: Underwater currents reverse direction every 30 seconds, pulling player toward crushing pressure zones — must use terrain and seismic pulses to counterbalance

pickup.name: Tidebreaker Core Fragment
pickup.effect: The Golem drops a fractured piece of its core — it glows with latent geomantic energy, and when held, it pulses in sync with the Echo Shard

encounters.trigger: After retrieving the Echo Shard, the Resonance Compass begins to scream — the ocean floor cracks open, revealing the Golem, forged from ancient stone and the bones of drowned geomancers.

boss.name: The Leviathan of Echoed Stone
boss.weakness: The resonant core is vulnerable to harmonic vibrations emitted by the Echo Shard — the only item capable of disrupting its geomantic resonance
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the resonant core after shattering its three obsidian shields

level.objective: The player must navigate three escalating encounters, each revealing a tool that unlocks the next, culminating in the Leviathan’s lair. The final boss is immune to direct damage — only the Echo Shard, tuned with the Tidebreaker Core Fragment, can disrupt its resonance and expose its core.
level.reward: After defeating the Leviathan, the player unlocks the 'Tidecaller's Will' ability — allows them to manipulate water pressure and shape underwater terrain for 10 seconds

level.theme: Harmony, not destruction — the beastmaster does not conquer, but understands. Each enemy is a misunderstood creature, and each pickup is a key to communication.
level.setting: A vast, sun-dappled underwater realm where coral towers glow with soft light, kelp forests sway in slow currents, and schools of iridescent fish move like living ribbons. No violent storms, no predators hunting — only quiet wonders and ancient, sleeping guardians. The mood is meditative, like floating through a dream beneath the waves.

enemy.name: Glowfin Jelly
enemy.weakness: Player's default Spear

encounters.hazard: Gentle current that pushes player toward next area

pickup.name: Bioluminescent Polyp
pickup.effect: Grants passive bioluminescence: nearby sea life glow faintly for 30 seconds

encounters.trigger: Player collects Bioluminescent Polyp → triggers current to carry them to next zone

enemy.name: Silt Stalker Crab
enemy.weakness: Bioluminescent Polyp (reveals hidden path)

encounters.hazard: Fine silt clouds obscure vision; only glowing creatures are visible

pickup.name: Harmonic Pearl
pickup.effect: Summons a gentle sonic pulse that attracts nearby sea creatures

encounters.trigger: Player defeats Silt Stalker Crab → sonic pulse lures Leviathan’s aura toward next chamber

enemy.name: Whispering Angler
enemy.weakness: Harmonic Pearl (overloads its lure with harmonic resonance)

encounters.hazard: Low-frequency hum disorients movement; player must follow glowing paths

pickup.name: Luminous Pearl
pickup.effect: Reveals the hidden Luminous Pearl buried in the seabed

encounters.trigger: Player collects Luminous Pearl → Leviathan awakens in the Sunken Spire

boss.name: Ancient Leviathan
boss.victory_condition: Use the Luminous Pearl to expose the Leviathan's weak point

level.objective: Guide the beastmaster through three serene underwater encounters, using environmental harmony and acquired trinkets to overcome foes — culminating in a peaceful resolution with the Ancient Leviathan.
level.reward: The Leviathan bows its head, and the sea calms — the player gains the title 'Keeper of the Deep' and unlocks the Coral Sanctuary as a rest zone.

level.theme: Ominous — the player is never alone. Shadows move when not looked at. Murmurs in dead languages whisper from the walls. The ocean is not a void — it is a graveyard that remembers.
level.setting: A forgotten undersea necropolis, where the bones of ancient necromancers are fused with coral and whalebone. Bioluminescent fungi pulse like dying stars. Silence is broken only by the groaning of shifting structures and the distant wailing of lost souls.

enemy.name: Whispering Shade
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to *Soul Chains* — a weapon upgrade unlocked after defeating the first enemy

encounters.hazard: Low visibility, drifting kelp that slows movement

pickup.name: Echoing Choirbone
pickup.effect: Unlocks *Soul Chains* — a whip-like tether that drains life from enemies and stuns them on hit

encounters.trigger: When the player enters the cathedral, the Shade emerges from a shattered stained-glass saint. As it dies, its ribcage collapses into a glowing bone — the *Echoing Choirbone* — which resonates with the necromancer’s staff

enemy.name: Coral Goliath
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to *Soul Chains* when wrapped around its core coral spine — this exposes its pulsing heart

encounters.hazard: Bioluminescent algae that blinds the player when disturbed; pressure zones that crush if lingered in too long

pickup.name: Heart of the First Necromancer
pickup.effect: Grants *Heart of the First Necromancer* — a pulsing organ that amplifies soul absorption and reveals hidden necrotic pathways

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Coral Goliath, its spine shatters, revealing a fleshy, still-beating organ — the *Heart of the First Necromancer*. The ground trembles as distant bones begin to rattle, signaling the Archon’s awakening. The water turns blood-red as the path to the Trench of the Drowned opens

enemy.name: Soul Eater Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Its hide is impervious unless pierced by *Soul Chains* while the *Heart of the First Necromancer* is active — the Heart’s resonance makes its flesh temporarily translucent

encounters.hazard: Sonic pulses from buried bells that disrupt spellcasting; schools of undead eels that latch onto the player and drain mana

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is a trap encounter designed to test mastery of prior mechanics

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Leviathan causes the seafloor to crack open, revealing the final chamber — the Archon’s throne room. The *Heart of the First Necromancer* pulses violently as the Archon’s voice echoes: 'You wore my skin. Now you shall wear my crown.'

boss.name: The Drowned Archon
boss.weakness: The Archon’s crown is bound to the *Heart of the First Necromancer* — only its resonance can unravel its necrotic shell
boss.victory_condition: Player must have the *Heart of the First Necromancer* and use it to shatter the Archon’s bone crown

level.objective: Survive the three escalating encounters, acquire the Heart, and use it to shatter the Archon’s bone crown
level.reward: The Archon’s Crown — allows the player to command drowned spirits as temporary minions

level.theme: The sea remembers. It feeds. It sings. And it hungers for the storm.
level.setting: A collapsed deep-sea research station, now fused with a living abyssal entity. The ocean above is dead. Below… is alive, and hungry.
level.player_weapon: Chain Lightning Gauntlet — fires bolts that arc between enemies. Cooldown: 3.5s. Upgradable with pickups.

encounters.location: The Gloom Trench — a narrow canyon choked with bioluminescent coral and ruptured submersible wreckage.

enemy.name: Riptide Warden
enemy.weakness: Stormcaller’s Chain Lightning — when amplified by the Conductive Coral, it arcs through all three of the Warden’s neural tentacles simultaneously.

encounters.hazard: Pressurized Currents — slow movement and drain stamina if player lingers.

pickup.name: Conductive Coral
pickup.effect: Conductive Coral — allows Chain Lightning to chain to 3 targets instead of 1. Lasts 30 seconds or until used.

encounters.trigger: Player enters the trench. Warden activates when player passes the first wrecked drone.

encounters.location: The Echoing Choir — a cathedral-like cavern lined with singing quartz pillars that amplify sound.

enemy.name: Siren of the Deep
enemy.weakness: Conductive Coral residue — the residue on the Siren’s skin conducts a Surge Pulse, overloading her sonic resonance nodes.

encounters.hazard: Sonic Vortexes — disorients player, distorts controls, and pulls toward center unless countered with Stormcaller’s Thunderclap.

pickup.name: Resonant Tidal Shard
pickup.effect: Resonant Tidal Shard — emits a harmonic pulse that reveals hidden paths and weak points in enemies. Lasts until boss fight.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Riptide Warden, the Siren’s song begins. The coral residue left on the floor glows faintly — player must use Conductive Coral within 15 seconds to trigger her emergence.

encounters.location: The Hall of Lost Voices — a circular chamber lined with floating, half-dissolved bodies, all whispering in unison.

enemy.name: The Kraken’s Echo
enemy.weakness: Resonant Tidal Shard — the shard’s pulse disrupts its psychic link to the Abyssal Maw, causing it to phase out of sync and become vulnerable for 8 seconds.

encounters.hazard: Mind Drift — player’s vision flickers with memories of drowned crewmates, reducing aim stability. Only the Resonant Tidal Shard’s pulse can stabilize perception.

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final encounter before the boss.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Siren, the Resonant Tidal Shard begins to hum. The Hall of Lost Voices activates as the water turns viscous and dark. The Kraken’s Echo rises from the bodies only if the Shard is held — if player dropped it, the fight does not trigger (brutal consequence).

boss.name: The Abyssal Maw
boss.weakness: Resonant Tidal Shard — the shard vibrates at the exact frequency of the Maw’s internal core, destabilizing its bio-luminescent containment field.
boss.victory_condition: Strike the Heart of the Maw with the Resonant Tidal Shard

level.objective: Survive the trench, the choir, and the hall — then strike the Maw’s core with the Resonant Tidal Shard.
level.reward: Tidal Sovereignty — unlocks Stormcaller’s ultimate: Tidal Surge, a localized tsunami that drowns all enemies in a 15m radius.

level.theme: Eerie silence is the deadliest sound — and the only thing that can kill the things that live in it.
level.setting: A forgotten underwater city, half-buried in silt and algae, where the last survivors used sonic rituals to communicate with the abyss — and accidentally summoned something that now sings their bones.
level.player_weapon: Shadowblade — a curved dagger that leaves no trail, absorbs ambient sound, and deals bonus damage to enemies that rely on resonance or bioluminescence

encounters.location: The Whispering Trench — a narrow canyon lined with glowing, sentient coral that hums with the echoes of drowned sailors

enemy.name: Glowfin Wraith
enemy.weakness: Shadowblade’s Silence Slash — the enemy’s bioluminescent skin is disrupted by silent movement, causing its glow to flicker and destabilize

encounters.hazard: Pulsing coral that emits low-frequency pulses — if player moves too quickly, the pulses sync with the enemy’s rhythm, amplifying its attacks

pickup.name: Silence Shard
pickup.effect: Grants Shadowblade the ability to perform ‘Silence Slash’ — a silent dash-attack that leaves no ripple, silencing nearby ambient sound for 3 seconds

encounters.trigger: Player enters the trench — coral pulses accelerate as the Wraith rises from the silt. The Wraith’s glow intensifies with every splash or swim, but remains inert if the player moves without disturbing water.

encounters.location: The Choir Ruins — a cathedral-like ruin of collapsed stone pipes and coral bells, once used to sing the drowned to sleep

enemy.name: Chorus of the Deep
enemy.weakness: Silence Shard — the enemy is a collective of psychic eel-spirits that communicate via harmonic resonance; silence disrupts their cohesion, forcing them into isolated, vulnerable states

encounters.hazard: Floating, shattered choir organs — if touched, they emit disorienting harmonic tones that scramble the player’s direction and briefly disable Shadowblade’s stealth

pickup.name: Heartlight Shard
pickup.effect: Grants Heartlight Shard — a pulsing bioluminescent core that emits a low, clear tone when held. When activated, it resonates with nearby sound-emitting objects and reveals hidden paths

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Glowfin Wraith, the Silence Shard causes the coral in the trench to dim. In the silence, distant chimes begin to echo — guiding the player toward the Choir Ruins. The Chorus awakens only when the Silence Shard is activated nearby.

encounters.location: The Data Maw — a collapsed deep-sea research station, its monitors still flickering with corrupted footage of the player’s own past dives

enemy.name: The Siren of Static
enemy.weakness: Heartlight Shard — the Siren is a corrupted data-entity woven from drowned sonar and memory. The Heartlight’s pure tone overwrites her dissonant frequencies, causing her form to glitch and become physically tangible

encounters.hazard: Static fields — zones of warped water that distort vision and delay the player’s attack animation. Activating the Heartlight Shard temporarily clears these fields

pickup.name: Echo Veil Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ‘Echo Veil’ ability — player can briefly phase through solid objects by emitting the Heartlight’s tone, but only when no enemies are near

encounters.trigger: The Chorus’s final note shatters the choir organ above the Data Maw’s entrance. The static fields activate as the Siren’s voice whispers the player’s forgotten name. Only by using the Heartlight Shard to clear the static can the player see the Siren’s true form.

boss.name: The Drowned Lich
boss.weakness: The Heartlight Shard — the resonant relic collected in Encounter 2 — emits a frequency that shatters the Lich’s bone armor when amplified by its own submerged chime
boss.victory_condition: Strike the Lich's core with the Heartlight Shard while it is vulnerable to its own resonance

level.objective: Ascend through the drowned ruins to confront the Lich, who has been whispering to you since the first pulse of the coral.
level.reward: The Lich’s Crown — allows the Shadowblade to permanently silence all ambient enemy sounds in future levels

level.setting: A drowned, bioluminescent city swallowed by a rogue thermal vent. The water is thick with ash, heat distortion, and floating debris. Pressure waves pulse unpredictably. Bubbles rise in spirals, igniting into brief firestorms when touched by flame.

enemy.name: Scalded Gills,
enemy.weakness: Ignition Burst (player's basic ability)

encounters.hazard: Oil Slicks

pickup.name: Pyro-Siphon Core
pickup.effect: Releases a volatile Pyro-Siphon Core (collectable)

encounters.trigger: Player ignites 3 Oil Slicks

enemy.name: Frostbloom Hydra
enemy.weakness: Pyro-Siphon Core (must be active to destabilize its cryo-core)

encounters.hazard: Freezing Currents (slows movement, extinguishes fire)

pickup.name: Maelstrom Core Fragment
pickup.effect: Releases the Maelstrom Core Fragment (collectable)

encounters.trigger: Player channels Pyro-Siphon Core into 3 Frostbloom Hydra cores

enemy.name: Tidal Wraith
enemy.weakness: Maelstrom Core Fragment (must be embedded in Wraith's spine to shatter its containment field)

encounters.hazard: Shattered Glass Corridors (debris deals damage, reflects fire unpredictably)

pickup.name: Final Maelstrom Key
pickup.effect: Releases the Final Maelstrom Key (collectable)

encounters.trigger: Player shatters 4 Glass Corridors using reflected fire while channeling Maelstrom Core Fragment

boss.name: The Maelstrom Maw
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Core while channeling the Pyro-Siphon

level.objective: Survive three escalating underwater chaos encounters and defeat the Maelstrom Maw using the power of the Pyro-Siphon Core
level.reward: The Infernal Tide - unlocks fire-based water displacement ability

level.theme: Desolation. Isolation. The cost of guardianship.
level.setting: A sunken civilization of biomechanical ruins, choked by silt and haunted by the echoes of dead wardens. No sunlight. Only the hum of dying machinery and the whispers of the deep.
level.player_weapon: Sonar Lance — emits piercing harmonic pulses. Limited ammo (8 shots). Reload: 5s. Deals bonus damage to bio-mechanical targets.

enemy.name: Silt Stalker
enemy.weakness: Warden's Sonar Lance (primary weapon)

encounters.hazard: Silt Clouds (reduce visibility, slow movement)

pickup.name: Sonar Pulse Module
pickup.effect: Unlocks Sonar Pulse (passive): Reveals hidden enemies and environmental hazards for 8s on weapon reload

encounters.trigger: Player enters trench. Silt Clouds activate. Silt Stalker emerges from sediment when Sonar Pulse is first used.

enemy.name: Chorus Kraken
enemy.weakness: Sonar Pulse Module (acquired from Encounter 0)

encounters.hazard: Resonance Feedback Field (damages player if moving while Sonar Pulse is active)

pickup.name: Echo Core
pickup.effect: Unlocks Echo Core: Emits a burst of harmonic energy that disrupts bio-mechanical systems

encounters.trigger: Player uses Sonar Pulse in the Ruins to navigate. Kraken is drawn to the pulse. If player avoids using Sonar Pulse, Kraken remains dormant until player enters the central chamber.

enemy.name: Grief Leviathan
enemy.weakness: Echo Core (acquired from Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Pressure Collapse Zones (instant death if player stands in for >2s)

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — final encounter. Player must survive to reach boss.

encounters.trigger: Player enters Archive and triggers the Leviathan’s awakening by retrieving the last transmission — which also unlocks the path to the boss chamber. The Leviathan is immune to Sonar Pulse and only vulnerable to Echo Core bursts.

boss.name: The Last Warden
boss.victory_condition: Use the Echo Core to shatter the Resonance Cage

level.objective: Survive the desolate deep and confront the last guardian of the drowned world.
level.reward: The Warden’s Silence — unlocks ability to move silently underwater, reducing enemy detection radius by 70%.

level.setting: A sunken, candy-colored underwater realm where coral grows like spun sugar, jellyfish drift like lanterns, and the water itself shimmers with playful light. Everything bounces, glows, or chimes gently. Sound travels in rainbow ripples.
level.player_weapon: Mirage Wand — casts fleeting, non-damaging illusions that can distract, lure, or temporarily hide the player

enemy.name: Bubbly Blunderfish
enemy.weakness: Bubble Charm

encounters.hazard: Floating bubbles that pop if touched

pickup.name: Bubble Charm
pickup.effect: Player gains Bubble Charm — allows casting a harmless, floating bubble that lures enemies and slows them briefly

encounters.trigger: Player collects Bubble Charm — floating bubbles in the grotto rearrange into a path leading to the next chamber

enemy.name: Chimecrab
enemy.weakness: Prism Shard

encounters.hazard: Resonant seashells that emit harmonic pulses when stepped on

pickup.name: Prism Shard
pickup.effect: Player gains Prism Shard — refracts light into colorful beams that can illuminate hidden objects and stun enemies briefly

encounters.trigger: Player uses Prism Shard to refract light through the seashells, causing them to chime in sequence and open a hidden tunnel to the Jelly Queen's throne room

enemy.name: Glow-Squid Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Bubble Charm and Prism Shard combined

encounters.hazard: Dark currents that disrupt illusions

pickup.name: Prism Jelly
pickup.effect: Player gains Prism Jelly — a pulsating, iridescent orb that amplifies and reflects light-based effects

encounters.trigger: Player defeats Glow-Squid and collects Prism Jelly — the jelly begins to glow in rhythm with distant pulsing, revealing the entrance to the throne room

boss.name: The Glimmering Jelly Queen
boss.victory_condition: Reflect the Jelly Queen's bioluminescent pulse back at her using the Prism Jelly

level.objective: Navigate three whimsical underwater chambers, collect three magical pickups, and use them strategically to defeat each enemy and the final boss. All weaknesses reference prior pickups. No combat is required to progress — only clever use of illusions and collected items.
level.reward: The Crown of Reflection — lets the player cast double illusions, turning every illusion into a decoy that confuses enemies

level.theme: The jungle doesn't just kill you — it *learns* from you.
level.setting: A sentient jungle where trees scream when wounded, vines hunt prey, and predators evolve in real-time based on player actions — the chaos is not random, it’s alive.
level.player_weapon: Beastmaster Whip — lassos enemies, pulls them in, entangles for crowd control

encounters.location: Canopy Ruins — tangled vines, broken stone pillars

enemy.name: Thornback Stalker
enemy.weakness: Player’s Beastmaster Whip (default weapon) can entangle its spines — stunning it for 3s

encounters.hazard: Poisonous Mist Pools (deal 10 DPS if stood in)

pickup.name: Whip Resonance Crystal
pickup.effect: Whip Upgrades: +20% entangle duration (now 4.5s)

encounters.trigger: Player enters the Canopy Ruins — vines snap alive and Thornback Stalker emerges from the mist

encounters.location: Echo Gorge — vertical cliffs, suspended roots, humming stone monoliths

enemy.name: Screaming Viper Nest
enemy.weakness: Whip Resonance Crystal’s sonic frequency disrupts the Vipers’ harmonic shriek — causing them to panic and attack each other

encounters.hazard: Territory Collapse — floor sections give way under weight, triggering falling logs and venomous vines

pickup.name: Screaming Vine Core
pickup.effect: Summons a 10s sonic pulse that stuns all nearby enemies — usable once

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Thornback Stalker, the Whip Resonance Crystal pulses — causing the ground below to tremble and the Screaming Viper Nest to awaken from its monolith hive

encounters.location: Heart of the Howl — floating islands above a churning fungal lake, bones embedded in trees

enemy.name: Chaos Maw Pack
enemy.weakness: Screaming Vine Core’s sonic pulse can fracture the psychic link binding the Pack — causing them to turn on each other in frenzy

encounters.hazard: Predator Swarm — wild beasts (jaguars, vultures, poison frogs) spawn randomly and attack both player and enemies

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final encounter before boss

encounters.trigger: After the Screaming Viper Nest is destroyed, the Screaming Vine Core activates — the ground rips open and the Chaos Maw Pack bursts forth, drawn by the Core’s frequency

boss.name: The Maw of Vorthax
boss.weakness: Screaming Vine Core disrupts Vorthax’s sonic resonance field — player must fire the Core into its throat during its howl phase
boss.victory_condition: Player must have collected the 'Screaming Vine Core' from Encounter 2

level.objective: Survive the jungle’s chaos — use the environment, enemy weaknesses, and acquired pickups to reach the Maw of Vorthax
level.reward: Vorthax’s Heart — unlocks the 'Jungle Tyrant' class upgrade: summon a primal beast that absorbs enemy attacks and retaliates with sonic screams

level.theme: The jungle remembers. You are not hunting — you are being judged.
level.setting: A primordial jungle choked with bioluminescent vines, where sounds echo unnaturally and shadows move when unobserved. Ancient ruins half-swallowed by roots hint at forgotten rituals.

enemy.name: Thornmaw Stalker
enemy.weakness: Ranger's Longbow (player weapon)

encounters.hazard: Thorn Vines (slow movement, damage over time)

pickup.name: Echoing Thorn
pickup.effect: Grants Echoing Thorn — a vine-tipped arrow that emits haunting echoes when fired

encounters.trigger: Player enters Grotto — vines activate, Stalker emerges from shadows

enemy.name: Whispering Lurker
enemy.weakness: Echoing Thorn (acquired from Encounter 0)

encounters.hazard: Echo Pools (distort sound, reveal hidden enemies)

pickup.name: Heartwood Compass
pickup.effect: Grants Heartwood Compass — points toward the next target and resonates with hidden magic

encounters.trigger: After defeating Stalker, vines retract — path opens to Hollow. Echoes from the Thorn reveal Lurker’s position in the mist

enemy.name: Mistborn Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Heartwood Compass (acquired from Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Obscuring Mist (blocks vision, random movement)

pickup.name: Veilkey
pickup.effect: Reveals the hidden path to the Veil-Watcher’s altar — activates the final encounter

encounters.trigger: After defeating Lurker, Compass glows intensely — mist parts to reveal chasm. Sentinel emerges from the mist to guard the path forward

boss.name: The Veil-Watcher
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Veil-Watcher using the Echoing Thorn

level.objective: Survive the jungle’s hidden terrors. Use your bow and acquired artifacts wisely — each enemy’s weakness is tied to your past victories.
level.reward: The Veil-Watcher’s Heart — unlocks the ‘Spirit Whisperer’ achievement and grants permanent camouflage in jungle biomes

level.theme: The jungle does not want you here. It remembers your breath. It remembers your blood.
level.setting: A forgotten jungle temple where the trees breathe and vines hunt. Fog never lifts. Sounds are muffled. Every step echoes — but not the way you think.

enemy.name: Jungle Stalker
enemy.weakness: Poisoned Dagger

encounters.hazard: Toxic Mist

pickup.name: Poisoned Dagger
pickup.effect: Dagger gains Poison on hit (5s duration)

encounters.trigger: Player steps into Murkroot Thicket, mist activates. Enemy spawns only when player attempts to climb vines to escape.

enemy.name: Vine Warden
enemy.weakness: Tear of the Moon Orchid

encounters.hazard: Living Vines

pickup.name: Tear of the Moon Orchid
pickup.effect: Grants invisibility for 8s when used; reveals enemy weak points

encounters.trigger: Player defeats Stalker and collects Poisoned Dagger — vines retract slightly, revealing a hidden path upward. The Warden emerges only after the player climbs into the canopy.

enemy.name: Thorned Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Viper’s Fang

encounters.hazard: Spore Burst

pickup.name: Viper’s Fang
pickup.effect: Replaces Dagger with Viper’s Fang — a single-use, unblockable piercing strike that ignores armor

encounters.trigger: Player uses Tear of the Moon Orchid to evade the Warden — the orchid’s essence attracts the Sentinel, who awakens from its petrified state. Player must now descend into the grotto to escape — and the path to the Matriarch opens only after the Sentinel is slain with the Fang.

boss.name: The Whispering Vine Matriarch
boss.victory_condition: Use the Viper’s Fang on its core

level.objective: Survive the jungle. Kill 3 guardians. Use the Viper’s Fang on the Matriarch's core.
level.reward: Heart of the Jungle — grants permanent stealth and +15% damage against poison-affected enemies

level.setting: A sun-dappled jungle where time moves slowly, water sings through moss, and every leaf hums a forgotten lullaby. No violence is needed — only resonance, patience, and reverence.

enemy.name: Vine-Snared Stalker
enemy.weakness: Susceptible to the Warden’s Whispering Vine — its thorny tendrils recoil from the vine’s gentle vibration.

encounters.hazard: Glowing spore patches on the ground emit drowsy mist if stepped on. Avoid or use to mask movement.

pickup.name: Whispering Vine
pickup.effect: Unlocks Whispering Vine — a vine-like weapon that emits a soothing hum, disrupting enemy neural rhythms.

encounters.trigger: Player steps into the Glade. Spores flare gently as the Stalker emerges from hanging vines.

enemy.name: Glowwing Swarm
enemy.weakness: Disrupted by the harmonic resonance of the Whispering Vine — its buzz forces the insects to scatter in disorientation.

encounters.hazard: Floating pollen clouds refract light into blinding patterns. Stand still to see the path; move too fast and you’ll lose direction.

pickup.name: Moonpetal Bloom
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Moonpetal Bloom — a luminescent flower that resonates at a frequency attuned to ancient forest spirits.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Stalker, the Whispering Vine’s hum draws the Glowwing Swarm from the canopy. The swarm’s glow dims as the vine vibrates nearby.

enemy.name: Rootbound Goliath
enemy.weakness: The Goliath’s bark-shell hardens when still — but vibrates weakly when the Whispering Vine is active. Its weakness is amplified if the Moonpetal Bloom is held nearby.

encounters.hazard: Roots surge from the earth to trip or entangle the player. Use the Whispering Vine’s hum to temporarily freeze root movement.

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — this is the final encounter before the boss.

encounters.trigger: The Glowwing Swarm’s scattered particles settle into glowing glyphs on the ground, forming a path leading to the Roots. As the player approaches, the Goliath rises from the earth, sensing the Bloom’s presence.

boss.name: Ancient Canopy Sentinel
boss.weakness: The Ancient Canopy Sentinel is vulnerable to the harmonic resonance of the Moonpetal Bloom — a rare plant that emits a frequency only detectable by the Warden’s Whispering Vine.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Sentinel using the Moonpetal Bloom

level.objective: Sanctify the Sacred Canopy — clear the jungle’s corruption by defeating three guardians and awakening the Sentinel with harmony.
level.reward: The Forest’s Lullaby — a passive ability that reduces all enemy aggression by 30% and heals 2 HP/sec while standing still in lush vegetation.

level.theme: Death is not an end — it is a cycle. And you are the weaver.
level.setting: An ancient jungle where the trees grow from the graves of dead priests. The air is thick with spores that whisper the names of the fallen. No sunlight penetrates the canopy. The only light comes from glowing fungi and the pulsing hearts of the undead.

encounters.location: Entrance Clearing — gnarled roots twist into skeletal faces. A single, pulsing *Soul-Bloom* flower hangs above a burial mound.

enemy.name: Whispering Vines
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to *Bone Siphon* — the necromancer’s default weapon ability that drains life from undead. The vines are animated by trapped souls; a successful Bone Siphon disrupts their necrotic tether.

encounters.hazard: The ground is covered in creeping, sentient vines that deal 5 HP/sec damage if the player stands still. Movement is required to avoid damage.

pickup.name: Soul-Bloom
pickup.effect: Collecting the Soul-Bloom grants the player *Soul Siphon: Amplified* — Bone Siphon now heals the necromancer for 15% of damage dealt and leaves behind a lingering soul-gas cloud that slows enemies by 40% for 5 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Whispering Vines, the Soul-Bloom blooms fully. As the player collects it, the ground trembles. A deep, guttural chanting rises from the east. The vines collapse into dust, revealing a hidden path lined with carved bone totems — leading to Encounter 1.

encounters.location: Bone Pathway — a narrow trail flanked by totems shaped like screaming primates. The air reeks of rot. Distant howls echo.

enemy.name: Carrion Stalkers (x3)
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to *Soul-Gas Cloud* — the lingering effect from the Soul-Bloom. The Stalkers are armored in hardened chitin that resists direct damage, but the soul-gas corrodes their joints, causing them to stagger and become open to critical strikes.

encounters.hazard: The path is lined with pressure plates that summon spectral flies — if stepped on, they explode in a 3ft radius, silencing spellcasting for 2 seconds. The player must leap over them or use Soul-Gas Cloud to neutralize them from range.

pickup.name: Bone Shards Core
pickup.effect: When all three Stalkers are defeated, their chitin shells fuse into a single *Bone Shards Core*. Picking it up grants the player *Bone Shards: Soul-Infused* — the player’s bone projectiles now explode on impact, releasing a 2ft radius Soul-Gas Cloud (10s duration).

encounters.trigger: As the player picks up the Bone Shards Core, the totems shatter. A massive vine root erupts from the earth ahead, tearing open a cavern entrance. Inside, a deep, rhythmic heartbeat pulses. The ground glows faintly red. The Hollow Matriarch’s lair is revealed — but the final piece lies within the corpse of her last guardian.

encounters.location: Heartroot Cavern — a cathedral of roots and ribs. The ceiling drips with black ichor. At the center: the Sentinel kneels, cradling a pulsing crimson stone.

enemy.name: The Hollow Matriarch’s Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Vulnerable to *Soul-Infused Bone Shards* — the explosive, lingering cloud effect from the Bone Shards Core. The Sentinel is encased in a shield of petrified flesh and bone, impervious to all other attacks. Only the Soul-Gas Cloud from the Bone Shards Core can erode its shield over time.

encounters.hazard: The cavern is filled with suspended corpses hanging from chains. If the player shoots a corpse, it detonates, releasing a burst of toxic spores (15 HP/sec for 8s). The only safe path is marked by glowing blue fungi — which only appear when Bone Shards Core is active and the player fires into the air.

pickup.name: Heartstone Fragments
pickup.effect: When the Sentinel falls, the crimson stone shatters. From its core, a shower of crystalline bone shards emerges — each one humming with stolen soul-energy. Collecting them grants the player *Heartstone Fragments* — a single-use, area-denial ability that launches 12 Soul-Infused Bone Shards in a 10ft radius, instantly removing the Sentinel’s shield and revealing the Hollow Matriarch’s Heartstone.

encounters.trigger: Upon collecting the Heartstone Fragments, the cavern walls split open. The Hollow Matriarch rises from the earth — her body woven from vines, bone, and the fused remains of a hundred sacrificed druids. The Heartstone glows in her chest. The Fragments vibrate in the necromancer’s hand — they are the only thing that can pierce it.

boss.name: The Hollow Matriarch
boss.weakness: The Heartstone is vulnerable to *Soul-Infused Bone Shards* — the final pickup from Encounter 3.
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Heartstone embedded in her chest

level.objective: Use each encounter’s pickup to defeat the next. The final boss cannot be damaged without the Heartstone Fragments. The level is designed to reward precision, environmental awareness, and strategic use of chain-reaction pickups.
level.reward: The Matriarch’s Crown — unlocks the *Soul Eater* class upgrade: gain 20% bonus health for each enemy soul consumed within 5 seconds of death.

level.theme: Nature is playful, not dangerous — but mischievous. Alchemy here is about harmony, not destruction.
level.setting: A jungle where trees giggle, vines sway to unheard music, and creatures dance instead of fight. Everything glows softly in pastel hues — pinks, teals, and lavenders. Fireflies hum lullabies.
level.player_weapon: Elixir Wand — fires slow-moving, splash-effect potions that can be charged for wider area

enemy.name: Snickering Sapling
enemy.weakness: Bubbling Bloom (acquired in this encounter)

encounters.hazard: Slippery moss patches that slow movement

pickup.name: Bubbling Bloom
pickup.effect: Releases a soft chime when thrown — stuns enemies for 3 seconds

encounters.trigger: Player steps on the glowing toadstool, causing vines to twitch and the Sapling to pop out from behind a giant mushroom

enemy.name: Chittering Chameleon
enemy.weakness: Bubbling Bloom (from Encounter 0) — the chameleon can’t change color when stunned

encounters.hazard: Floating pollen clouds that temporarily blur vision

pickup.name: Petal-Step Sap
pickup.effect: When consumed, grants a brief burst of double-jump and leaves a trail of glowing petals

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Sapling, the Bubbling Bloom’s chime echoes — causing a hidden vine bridge to lower, revealing the Chameleon camouflaged atop a floating lily pad

enemy.name: Dancing Dandelion
enemy.weakness: Petal-Step Sap (from Encounter 1) — the pollen trails disrupt its rhythm, making it stumble

encounters.hazard: Gravity-fluctuating air pockets that make jumps unpredictable

pickup.name: Harmonic Honey
pickup.effect: When poured into a hollow gourd, creates a sweet, resonant honey that harmonizes with natural frequencies

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Chameleon, the Petal-Step Sap trail leads to a spinning windmill made of leaves — beneath it, a gourd weeps golden nectar. The Dancing Dandelion dances atop it, trying to steal it

boss.name: The Giggling Gourd King
boss.victory_condition: Pour the Harmonic Honey into the Gourd's mouth while it's dancing

level.objective: Collect three whimsical alchemical essences to appease the Gourd King
level.reward: The Gourd King bows, gives the player the Crown of Curious Crystals — unlocks the 'Jungle Jester' skin and allows access to the hidden 'Laughing Lagoon' bonus area

level.theme: Eerie — Time is broken here. Everything remembers what hasn’t happened yet.
level.setting: An overgrown jungle choked with sentient flora and fractured time rifts. Trees grow backward from roots to canopy. Mist moves against the wind. Sounds echo in reverse. The air hums with temporal static.
level.player_weapon: Chrono-Scepter — fires pulses that slow or rewind time in short bursts

enemy.name: Whispering Vines
enemy.weakness: Temporal Echo

encounters.hazard: Slow field that drains 1% max mana per second if not escaped

pickup.name: Echo Seed
pickup.effect: Grants Temporal Echo — briefly rewind time 2 seconds after taking damage (1 use)

encounters.trigger: Player steps through the archway, triggering vines to animate from the trees and floor

enemy.name: Soul-Stitched Jaguar
enemy.weakness: Fractured Hourglass (from Encounter 2)

encounters.hazard: Time-lag puddles — stepping in slows player movement by 60% for 5s

pickup.name: Fractured Hourglass
pickup.effect: Grants Fractured Hourglass — shatter time in a 5m radius, freezing all enemies for 3s (1 use)

encounters.trigger: After defeating Whispering Vines, the Echo Seed activates and replays the last 5 seconds — revealing hidden path to temple where Jaguar waits

enemy.name: Echo Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Temporal Echo (from Encounter 0)

encounters.hazard: Repeating sound pulses that disorient player — direction controls invert for 4s every 8s

pickup.name: Chrono-Sigil
pickup.effect: Grants Chrono-Sigil — mark a point in time to return to later (1 use)

encounters.trigger: The Jaguar’s death causes its spirit to scream — time fractures, summoning the Echo Sentinel from a past iteration of this grove

boss.name: The Chrono-Wraith
boss.victory_condition: Strike the Chrono-Wraith with the Fractured Hourglass while it is in Temporal Echo mode

level.objective: Defeat the Chrono-Wraith by using the Fractured Hourglass during its Temporal Echo phase
level.reward: Abyssal Hourglass — permanently unlocks Time Echo ability: player can rewind entire level by 10s once per life

level.theme: Desolation — every sound is a memory. Every shadow, a warning. The jungle doesn’t kill you — it forgets you.
level.setting: The Verdant Grave — a once-holy jungle now choked by ancient curses. Trees grow crooked as broken bones. The air smells of rot and iron. Silence is the only constant — and the only lie.
level.player_weapon: Berserker Axe — high damage, slow swing, no range. On kill, grants 2s of 40% movement speed and 30% damage boost.

encounters.location: Crumbled Stone Altar — overgrown with rotting liana, broken idols, and pooled black water

enemy.name: Guttural Stalker
enemy.weakness: Player's Berserker Axe (basic weapon)

encounters.hazard: Venomous Vines — if player stands still for >3s, takes 15 damage/sec. Vines retract after enemy death.

pickup.name: Thirsting Vine
pickup.effect: Player gains Thirsting Vine — a symbiotic tendril that latches to the player’s back. When activated, it drains life from enemies within 5m over 5s, healing the player and weakening nearby foes by 30%.

encounters.trigger: Player steps onto cracked obsidian tile near altar — vines erupt from ground. Stalker emerges from shadow beneath altar.

encounters.location: Cavern of Hanging Chits — ceiling dripping with venom sacs, floor littered with hollowed-out skulls and chitinous shells

enemy.name: Viperkin Hive-Warden
enemy.weakness: Thirsting Vine (acquired from Encounter 0)

encounters.hazard: Swarm of Acid-Spitting Wasps — damage increases if player is low on health. Wasp nests explode on death of Warden, covering area in toxic fog.

pickup.name: Corrupted Viper Fang
pickup.effect: Player gains Corrupted Viper Fang — a fang harvested from the Warden’s jaw. When embedded into the ground, it emits a pulse that reveals hidden life-force conduits in enemies. When used in melee, it bypasses armor and drains 20% of target’s max HP as bonus damage.

encounters.trigger: After defeating Guttural Stalker, the Thirsting Vine reacts violently to the scent of venom — it thrashes toward the cavern entrance, forcing player to follow.

encounters.location: Temple of the Drowned God — flooded with stagnant water, stone pillars half-submerged, ghostly whispers echo in perfect silence

enemy.name: Soul-Sundered Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Corrupted Viper Fang (acquired from Encounter 1)

encounters.hazard: Echoing Silence Field — player’s movement and attack speed are reduced by 60%. Only damage from the Corrupted Viper Fang bypasses this field.

pickup.name: None
pickup.effect: None — player must enter boss arena immediately after defeat.

encounters.trigger: After defeating Viperkin Hive-Warden, the Corrupted Viper Fang begins to pulse. The ground beneath the player cracks open, revealing a spiral staircase descending into the temple’s heart.

boss.name: The Maw of Thul’gath
boss.weakness: The Corrupted Viper Fang (acquired from Encounter 2)
boss.victory_condition: Player must strike the Maw's heart-core with the Corrupted Viper Fang after draining its life-force via the Thirsting Vine

level.objective: Survive three brutal encounters and slay the Maw of Thul’gath using the power of the Corrupted Viper Fang, fueled by the Thirsting Vine's life-drain. Every step is a gamble — healing is scarce, and the jungle hungers for your soul.
level.reward: The Maw’s Heartcore — grants permanent +10% life-drain efficiency to Thirsting Vine and unlocks the 'Jungle God’s Scorn' achievement.
